unit: case-preserving ASCII letter count of each encoded token, not manuscript glyph count
metric: equal-locus mean of first-token length minus mean remaining-token length

cohort.rule: intersection of accepted locus keys across both sources and both spacing policies, requiring selected kind and locator in every case

null.definition: independently choose a uniformly random token as first within each fixed locus; remaining tokens retain their multiset
null.randomness: JSON-encoded seed/source/policy/locus context plus 16-byte big-endian replicate counter; shared HashDraws rejection sampling

variants.interpretation_limit: Conditioned encoded-token order reference; not a confirmatory p-value or evidence of decipherment

inference_limit: descriptive conditioned shuffle comparison; no confirmatory p-value, unseen-material claim, language identification, decipherment or translation
exposure: Whole-corpus exploratory analysis after source metadata and selected image exposure; no untouched evaluation set
